responsibility: Declares the derive expander for builtin #[derive(Default)] in the Rust macro-expansion layer. The DeriveDefault class extends the generic derive visitor API with helpers to build qualified Default::default calls, the default associated function body, and the surrounding core::default::Default impl, plus visit hooks for the supported item shapes that expansion uses to synthesize Default implementations.
same_name_distinction: Declaration side of the Default derive pair: it introduces the DeriveDefault class and helper APIs for constructing Default impl pieces, in contrast to rust-derive-default.cc, which performs the actual AST synthesis and error emission.
